visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman in a white long-sleeve shirt and white cap, alongside a man with a black backpack, stands in a brightly lit supermarket aisle. They pick up various snack bags, like yellow oat biscuit packs, turning them over to scrutinize the ingredient labels on the back with focused expressions. The background shows packed shelves of colorful chips and cookies under flat studio-like lighting. (2) The woman stands in front of a green snack display, holding a bag of "Fried Egg Flavor" chips. She points excitedly at the "Vegan" (全素) label on the back with a wide smile and raised eyebrows. The camera zooms in to show the text on the packaging clearly, capturing her joy as she discovers a unique snack she can eat. (3) The man stands alone near a refrigerated shelf holding a white paper-wrapped food item. He carefully reads the fine print on the back, his face transitioning from hopeful anticipation to a pained, disappointed grimace. A woman in a purple shirt briefly passes in the background. He holds the package close to his eyes before looking away in frustration.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) 0:00-0:11: Playful, high-tempo BGM featuring upbeat piano chords and light percussion creates a humorous atmosphere. A female voice with a friendly tone says "Oat eh," followed by a male "Hey." They list "Milk, butter" quickly. Periodic "pop" SFX occur as snacks are handled. (2) 0:12-0:14: A short, airy "whoosh" SFX triggers as the character quickly puts back a snack. The BGM tempo remains steady. The female voice repeats "Milk powder" in a fast, matter-of-fact speech rate with neutral arousal. (3) 0:15-0:24: A bright, crystalline "ding" discovery SFX triggers a shift in energy. The female voice exhibits high arousal and rising intonation, exclaiming "This seems okay!" and "Vegan edible!". Brief "sparkle" SFX textures are layered over the continuous BGM. (4) 0:25-0:31: The man's voice takes over, reading ingredients with a hopeful tone. A downward "slide whistle" SFX plays when he identifies "Butter," followed by a hopeful "ding" SFX as he discovers "Soy lecithin." The BGM rhythm syncs with his speech. (5) 0:32-0:35: A loud, comedic "cry" SFX or "wah-wah" trombone effect triggers as the man concludes reading "Milk powder." His vocal delivery becomes exaggerated and sad, with a falling pitch contour. The BGM concludes abruptly at the video end.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Intro -> Point 1: Fast checking -> Point 2: Accidental discovery -> Point 3: Final disappointment.
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video uses a humorous, vlog-style format to show the common experience of vegans shopping for snacks. It emphasizes the need to check every label and the mixture of excitement and disappointment found when discovering or failing to find vegan-friendly options.
